dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT tbi.budget_item_id, tbi.budget_item_name, group_concat(distinct tu.USER_FNAME,' ',tu.USER_LNAME) as owner_name, td.dept_name, tbi.start_time, tbi.end_time, tbi.head_count as available_head_count, ( SELECT SUM(IF(committed_position_count > 0,committed_position_count,0)) FROM ( SELECT tpo.budget_item_id, tpo.position_no_of_openings-COUNT(distinct tajh.applicant_id) as committed_position_count FROM tp_positions tpo LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_joining_history tajh ON(tajh.position_id=tpo.position_id) WHERE tpo.position_status IN (1,5) AND tpo.is_budget_committed = 1 GROUP BY tpo.position_id ) as tb WHERE tb.budget_item_id=tbi.budget_item_id ) as committed_head_count, (SELECT COUNT(applicant_id) FROM tp_applicant_joining_history WHERE budget_item_id=tbi.budget_item_id) as used_head_count, tbi.status FROM tp_budget_items tbi LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON (tu.user_id=tbi.owner_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON(td.dept_id=tbi.dept_id) @@ WHERE 1 AND status != 2 @@ GROUP BY budget_item_id ORDER BY budget_item_id, budget_item_name

INSERT INTO tp_budget_items ( budget_item_name, owner_id, start_time, end_time, dept_id, sub_dept_id, sub_sub_dept_id, sub3_dept_id, sub4_dept_id, grade_id, band_id, head_count, status, user_id, date_created) VALUES ( ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())

UPDATE tp_budget_items SET budget_item_name=?, owner_id=?, start_time=?, end_time=?, dept_id=?, sub_dept_id=?, sub_sub_dept_id=?, sub3_dept_id=?, sub4_dept_id=?, grade_id=?, band_id=?, head_count=?, status=? WHERE budget_item_id=?

SELECT @@ FROM tp_budget_items tbi LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON (tu.user_id=tbi.owner_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON(td.dept_id=tbi.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tds ON (tds.dept_id = tbi.sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdss ON (tdss.dept_id = tbi.sub_sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdsss ON (tdsss.dept_id = tbi.sub3_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdssss ON (tdssss.dept_id = tbi.sub4_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_positions tp ON(tp.budget_item_id = tbi.budget_item_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_step_users tpsu ON (tpsu.position_id = tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_grades tbg ON(tbg.grade_id = tbi.grade_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_bands tbb ON(tbb.band_id = tbi.band_id) WHERE 1 @@

SELECT tbi.end_time, tbi.head_count as available_head_count, ( SELECT SUM(IF(committed_position_count > 0,committed_position_count,0)) FROM ( SELECT tpo.budget_item_id, tpo.position_no_of_openings-COUNT(distinct tajh.applicant_id) as committed_position_count FROM tp_positions tpo LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_joining_history tajh ON(tajh.position_id=tpo.position_id) WHERE tpo.budget_item_id= ? AND tpo.position_id != ? AND tpo.position_status IN (1,5) AND tpo.is_budget_committed = 1 GROUP BY tpo.position_id ) as tb )as committed_head_count, (SELECT COUNT(applicant_id) FROM tp_applicant_joining_history WHERE budget_item_id=tbi.budget_item_id AND position_id != ?) as used_head_count FROM tp_budget_items tbi WHERE tbi.budget_item_id=?
UPDATE tp_budget_items SET head_count = head_count @@? WHERE budget_item_id=?

SELECT budget_item_id, budget_item_name, owner_id, start_time, end_time, dept_id, sub_dept_id, sub_sub_dept_id, sub3_dept_id, sub4_dept_id, grade_id, band_id, head_count , status, user_id FROM tp_budget_items WHERE budget_item_id=?
SELECT position_title FROM tp_positions tp WHERE budget_item_id=? AND position_status != 0
UPDATE tp_budget_items SET status=? WHERE budget_item_id=? AND (user_id=? OR owner_id=?)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END as can_modify FROM tp_budget_items WHERE budget_item_id=? AND (user_id=? OR owner_id=?)

SELECT tbi.budget_item_id, tbi.budget_item_name, concat(tu.USER_FNAME,' ',tu.USER_LNAME) as owner_name, td.dept_name, tds.dept_name as sub_dept_name, tdss.dept_name as sub_sub_dept_name, tbg.grade_name, tbb.band_name, tbi.head_count as available_head_count, tbi.start_time, tbi.end_time, tbi.status FROM tp_budget_items tbi LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON (tu.user_id=tbi.owner_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON(td.dept_id=tbi.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tds ON (tds.dept_id = tbi.sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdss ON (tdss.dept_id = tbi.sub_sub_dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_grades tbg ON(tbg.grade_id = tbi.grade_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_bands tbb ON(tbb.band_id = tbi.band_id) WHERE budget_item_id=?
SELECT budget_item_id FROM tp_budget_items WHERE budget_item_name = ? Limit 1
